name: text-char-offset-cycle
title: Character Offset Cycle
description: Mỗi ký tự bắt đầu lệch 10 bậc trong bảng chữ cái rồi đếm lùi từng bậc về đúng chữ, lần lượt từ trái sang.

moworks.author: takayu

credit.madeNote: written here from the idea and its numbers; none of the source's code

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-char-code-cycle, written here): Per char: shown char = target shifted forward k code points inside its class, wrapping (a–z, A–Z, 0–9, hiragana, katakana, CJK ideographs, fullwidth A–Z / a–z); k = ceil(10 × (1 − p_i)) (AE Character Offset 10 → 0); p_i = easeOutQuad over 1 s per char, chars staggered min(120 ms, 0.9 s/n) left → right from 0.4 s; integer steps, no fade; accent while k > 0. Demo loop: all ease back to +10 over 3.0–3.5 s (inQuad); loop 3.6 s. Mono font keeps widths. Params: offset: số bậc lệch ban đầu (10) · duration: mỗi ký tự (1 s) · stagger (0.12 s) · ease (easeOutQuad).
moworks.titleVi: Ký tự đếm lùi về đúng chữ
